name: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd
title: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd - 540975 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Aster Q4 FY26 revenue up 18% to INR 1,182 cr with operating EBITDA up 26% and margin 20.7%; capacity adds are disciplined (~2,500 beds over 4 years, INR 2,700 cr) with no sign of supply glut in the sector.

utilisation.quote: Aster CMI is at 60% plus occupancy, Aster RV is at 69%

capex.quote: Over the next four years, we plan to add ~2,500 beds at the cost of INR 2700 crores.

triggers.label: Whitefield occupancy ~55% after 150 beds added
triggers.quote: in Aster Whitefield we have added 150 beds so, if you include that, it (Aster Whitefield) has got still only 55% plus occupancy

triggers.label: K&M IP volume growth 3%
triggers.quote: in K&M, we have a positive 3% growth

triggers.label: Capacity to 8,150+ beds
triggers.quote: which will take our total capacity to over 8,150 beds

guidance.value: ~2,500 beds over coming years; capacity to 8,150+ beds
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to add nearly 2,500 beds over the coming years

guidance.value: No margin dilution; YoY margin growth expected
guidance.quote: we don't expect any margin dilution and year-on-year we'll grow in the margins
we expect to go to mid to high single digit
Based on current timelines, we expect the process to be completed within this quarter.

red_flags.label: Kerala nurse strike and wage settlement
red_flags.quote: Our total impact in Keral a will be INR 5 –6 crores.

red_flags.label: Middle East MVT softness
red_flags.quote: in the last few days , in the Middle East we have found that especially , from Oman and UAE less number of patients are flowing in

red_flags.label: Merger-driven one-time costs depress QCIL margin
red_flags.quote: there is this one time that impacts us broadly around, the one time that we're doing on merger

evasions.quote: We've still not started the work on Aster QCIL synergies really
I don't know where the INR 500 crores number is essentially
